class WorkItem:
    id: str
    change: str
    evidence: List[str]
    dependencies: List[str]
    proof: str


def validate_plan(items):
    if not items:
        raise ValueError("Plan cannot be empty")
    ids = [i.id for i in items]
    if len(ids) != len(set(ids)):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate work item identifier")
    known = set(ids)
    for it in items:
        if not it.id.strip():
            raise ValueError("Work item has no identifier")
        if not it.change.strip():
            raise ValueError(f"{it.id}: missing change description")
        if not it.evidence or not all(e.strip() for e in it.evidence):
            raise ValueError(f"{it.id}: missing evidence")
        if not it.proof.strip():
            raise ValueError(f"{it.id}: missing proof")
        if len(it.dependencies) != len(set(it.dependencies)):
            raise ValueError(f"{it.id}: duplicate dependency")
        for d in it.dependencies:
            if d == it.id:
                raise ValueError(f"{it.id}: depends on itself")
            if d not in known:
                raise ValueError(f"{it.id}: unknown dependency {d}")


def execution_waves(items):
    validate_plan(items)
    remaining = {i.id: set(i.dependencies) for i in items}
    done, waves = set(), []
    while remaining:
        ready = sorted(k for k, deps in remaining.items() if deps <= done)
        if not ready:
            raise ValueError("Dependency cycle detected among: " + ", ".join(sorted(remaining)))
        waves.append(ready)
        for k in ready:
            del remaining[k]
        done.update(ready)
    return waves"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"ep_1.py","headingEn":"main(): six experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಆರು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() schedules the lesson plan, tries eight defective plans, runs a cycle and its repair, computes a critical path from invented durations, passes a plan with vague evidence and writes the plan as JSON.","descKn":"main() lesson ಯೋಜನೆ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ, ಎಂಟು ದೋಷಯುಕ್ತ ಯೋಜನೆ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ, ಚಕ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ಅದರ ದುರಸ್ತಿ ಓಡಿಸಿ, ಕಾಲ್ಪನಿಕ ಅವಧಿಗಳಿಂದ critical path ಲೆಕ್ಕ ಹಾಕಿ, ಅಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯ ಇರುವ ಯೋಜನೆ ಪಾಸ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಯೋಜನೆಯನ್ನು JSON ಆಗಿ ಬರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():

def validate_plan(items):

        raise ValueError("Plan cannot be empty")
    ids = [i.id for i in items]
    if len(ids) != len(set(ids)):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate work item identifier")
    known = set(ids)
    for it in items:
        if not it.id.strip():
            raise ValueError("Work item has no identifier")
        if not it.change.strip():
            raise ValueError(f"{it.id}: missing change description")
        if not it.evidence or not all(e.strip() for e in it.evidence):
            raise ValueError(f"{it.id}: missing evidence")
        if not it.proof.strip():
            raise ValueError(f"{it.id}: missing proof")
        if len(it.dependencies) != len(set(it.dependencies)):
            raise ValueError(f"{it.id}: duplicate dependency")
        for d in it.dependencies:
            if d == it.id:

    d = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(65536), b""):
            d.update(chunk)
    return d.hexdigest()


def inspect_file(root, rel):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    target = (root / rel).resolve()
    if root != target and root not in target.parents:
        return {"source": rel, "status": "outside_root"}
    if not target.exists():
        return {"source": rel, "status": "missing"}
    if target.is_dir():
        return {"source": rel, "status": "directory"}
    return {"source": rel, "status": "found", "size": target.stat().st_size, "sha256": sha(target)[:12]}


def run_proof(command, cwd, timeout=20, expected=0):
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    try:
        p = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, check=False)
        r = {"exit_code": p.returncode, "timed_out": False, "stdout": p.stdout.strip()[-120:], "stderr": p.stderr.strip()[-120:]}
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        r = {"exit_code": None, "timed_out": True, "stdout": "", "stderr": ""}
    r["seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - t0, 2)
    r["passed"] = (not r["timed_out"]) and r["exit_code"] == expected
    return r


def tests_ran(stderr):
    import re
    m = re.search(r"Ran (\d+) test", stderr)
